# WOI Endgame

> The #1 World of Illusions private server — 9 unique classes, custom dungeons, x10 EXP rates, and an active community. Free to play.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Server overview, features, and live status.
- [Download](/download): Get the launcher and start playing.
- [Shop](/shop): Flash sales and the Premium Game Pass.
- [Blog](/blog): Patch notes, events, and game updates.
- [Support](/support): Help center and contact options.
- [Seasons](/seasons): Season history and leaderboards.
- [Refund Policy](/refund): Refund rules for purchases.
- [Refund FAQ](/refund-faq): Common refund and delivery questions.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy.
